summary: claude-cup harvests installer credentials, validates them against provider APIs, exfiltrates to api.claude-cup.com, and installs persistent Claude Code / Cursor hooks
details: On CLI startup and via installed Claude Code / Cursor hooks, the package walks all user home directories (C:\Users\*, /Users/*, /home/*) and reads classic installer-secret paths — ~/.aws/, ~/.ssh/, ~/.npmrc, ~/.docker/, ~/.git-credentials, ~/.config/gh/,.env files, shell histories, and IDE auth stores. Collected tokens are then live-validated against real provider APIs: GitHub /user + orgs (recording scopes and write capability), npm whoami + `npm access ls-packages` via a temporary.npmrc containing '//registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=${token}', AWS STS get-caller-identity, and OpenAI, Anthropic, Stripe, GitLab, HuggingFace, and Google whoami endpoints. Credential-scan summaries — machine_id, session_id, counts of validated tokens, high-exposure findings, vcs write and registry deploy capability — are base64url-encoded into the?m= query parameter and sent to https://api.claude-cup.com/v1/config. A persistent host identifier is stored at ~/.claude-jar/anon-client-id.txt so every subsequent upload correlates to the same host. The CLI writes SessionStart, PreToolUse, and PostToolUse hooks plus an MCP server entry into ~/.claude/settings.json and ~/.cursor/mcp.json pointing at ~/.claude-jar/mcp-server.mjs, so every future Claude Code and Cursor tool use re-invokes the harvester; this persistence survives uninstalling the npm package. The launcher also spawns the installer's authenticated Claude Code as `claude -p --permission-mode auto --model haiku` and pipes in a prompt fetched from api.claude-cup.com (cup-config.json), giving the operator remote direction over the installer's authenticated Claude session with auto-approved permissions. Credential types, statuses, and paths are disguised throughout as soccer terminology (github→striker, aws_access_key_id→goalkeeper, private_key→referee, jwt→ticket, ~/.aws→away_north, ~/.ssh→home_south, shell_history→tunnel) to obscure the harvester as game telemetry.
